Welcome to the **Ultralytics & Computer Vision For Developers** course. Follow the modules below in order to build your foundation in modern computer vision.

**GitHub Repository:** [NaifMersal/cv-for-developers-ultralytics](https://github.com/NaifMersal/cv-for-developers-ultralytics)

:::: {.course-container}
:::: {.course-grid}

::: {.card}
### 🖼️ Preparatory Module

*How computers perceive images.*

::: {.card-desc}
Learn about pixels, color channels, coordinate systems, and the basics behind digital cameras and computer vision libraries.
:::

::: {.card-links}
[**Presentation Slides**](slides/0_Image_Foundations.qmd)

[**Lab:** Images as N-Dimensional Arrays](https://colab.research.google.com/github/NaifMersal/cv-for-developers-ultralytics/blob/main/labs/00_images.ipynb) [![Open In Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/assets/colab-badge.svg)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/NaifMersal/cv-for-developers-ultralytics/blob/main/labs/00_images.ipynb)
:::

:::

### 🚀 Part 1: Tasks & Inference

*Discover what YOLO can do out of the box.*

::: {.card-desc}
Covers running inference for Object Detection, Instance Segmentation, Classification, and Pose Estimation using CLI and Python.
:::

::: {.card-links}
[**Presentation Slides**](slides/1_Tasks_Inference.qmd)

[**Lab:** YOLO Tasks & Inference](https://colab.research.google.com/github/NaifMersal/cv-for-developers-ultralytics/blob/main/labs/01_tasks_inference.ipynb) [![Open In Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/assets/colab-badge.svg)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/NaifMersal/cv-for-developers-ultralytics/blob/main/labs/01_tasks_inference.ipynb)
:::
:::

::: {.card}
### 🔍 Part 2: Use Cases & Solutions

*Beyond bounding boxes: actionable insights.*

::: {.card-desc}
Solutions for region analytics, kinematic tracking, video heatmaps, and setting up external integrations.
:::

::: {.card-links}
[**Presentation Slides**](slides/2_Real_World_Use_Cases.qmd)

[**Lab:** Real-World Solutions](https://colab.research.google.com/github/NaifMersal/cv-for-developers-ultralytics/blob/main/labs/02_solutions_expanded.ipynb) [![Open In Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/assets/colab-badge.svg)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/NaifMersal/cv-for-developers-ultralytics/blob/main/labs/02_solutions_expanded.ipynb)
:::
:::

### 🎥 Part 2B: Video Engineering (BONUS)

*Handling RTSP and Concurrency.*

::: {.card-desc}
Overcome I/O bottlenecks using Threading and Queues to ensure your inference loops remain real-time without blocking the UI.
:::

::: {.card-links}
[**Presentation Slides**](slides/2B_Real_World_Video_Engineering.qmd)

[**BONUS Lab:** Async Video Streaming](https://colab.research.google.com/github/NaifMersal/cv-for-developers-ultralytics/blob/main/labs/02b_video_engineering.ipynb) [![Open In Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/assets/colab-badge.svg)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/NaifMersal/cv-for-developers-ultralytics/blob/main/labs/02b_video_engineering.ipynb)
:::
:::

::: {.card}

*How good is your model?*

::: {.card-desc}

::: {.card-links}
[**Presentation Slides**](slides/3_Evaluation.qmd)

:::
